stem: The volumes, in litres, of juice in large and small bottles have the distributions $\text{N}(5.10, 0.0102)$ and $\text{N}(2.51, 0.0036)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total volume of juice in 3 randomly chosen large bottles and 4 randomly chosen small bottles is less than 25.5 litres.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the volume of juice in a randomly chosen large bottle is at least twice the volume of juice in a randomly chosen small bottle.
